parsed.summary: The PR introduces a micro-optimization by avoiding the instantiation of MaxLengthValidator when max_length is None. It also removes the unnecessary appending of validators to CharField.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify the behavior of Value._resolve_output_field() with the modified CharField.__init__ method. This could lead to regressions or unexpected behavior in the future.

The PR does not follow the project's convention of using a conditional statement to append validators. Instead, it directly modifies the CharField.__init__ method. This could lead to inconsistencies in the codebase.
